taste.use_when: The user browses clothes to learn their taste: a deck of pieces from their taste service to like or dislike, a swipe up for similar pieces, search, the taste map, and what their taste is.

taste_item.use_when: One piece of the taste feed as a sheet (its photo, price, Buy, like or dislike, similar pieces); the taste layout opens it with params {key} and loads /v1/taste/screens/item?key=<key>.
